title: The adic pullback is exact coefficient comparison
statement: Let X be any scheme and A a commutative coefficient ring of the independent size used for the equivalent small site models [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let Q_et and Q_pro be their standard derived localizations. For the normalized adic pullback F_A [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data] and the canonical termwise module comparison L_A [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-data], there is a natural isomorphism Q_et followed by F_A isomorphic to L_A followed by Q_pro. No boundedness, constructibility or Noetherian hypothesis is used.

proof.text: Apply constantInverseImageScalarNormalization to the recorded set-sheaf comparison adjunction and adicFiniteComparisonData. Its equality identifies the scalar map of the algebraic inverse-image lift with the transpose of the canonical constant-section ring map defining constructibleComparisonPullback. Multiplying by the inverse underlying-ring isomorphism gives the coefficient compatibility needed for the module adjunction.

Use the proved siteContinuousRingedTopos construction to realize this same continuous module pushforward with its transposed ring map. The proved supplied_module_adjunction helper in CompletedPullbackAdjunction restricts the geometric adjunction to additive, scalar-linear maps and then composes with the tensor/restriction adjunction. Its left functor is definitionally adicFiniteOrdinaryPullback. Uniqueness of left adjoints compares this adjunction with Mathlib pullbackPushforwardAdjunction, giving ordinaryComparison. Only this generic proved helper is used, not the completed-pullback theorem.

The canonical comparison preserves finite limits by constructibleComparisonPullback_exact_faithful and finite colimits by its left adjunction. Transport both properties through ordinaryComparison. Mathlib mapHomologicalComplex_upToQuasiIso_Q_inverts_quasiIso then says that ordinary adic pullback on complexes followed by the standard derived localization inverts every quasi-isomorphism.

The universal field of adicFinitePullbackData makes its comparison a left-derived counit. Since the complex functor inverts quasi-isomorphisms, Mathlib isIso_of_isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts makes this counit invertible. Compose its isomorphism with ordinaryComparison mapped termwise to complexes and whiskered by the target localization Q. This proves the displayed isomorphism without an additional derived-functor construction.

theorem adicExactComparison (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] :
    Nonempty (Q (constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A) ⋙
        adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X A ≅
      AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.constructibleComparisonComplexPullback X A ⋙
        Q (constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A))
